item.title: Android Notification DoS: When a GIF Crashes Your Phone (CVE-2025-48631 Incomplete Fix)
item.description: CVE-2025-48631 was marked as fixed in Android's December 2025 bulletin — but the fix was incomplete. Here's how I found the bypass.

item.title: Exploiting JavaScript Interface for Unauthorized Access in a 'global' cryptocurrency exchange android app
item.description: How I exploited an exposed JavaScript interface in a major crypto exchange's Android app to perform authenticated actions like placing trades and deactivating accounts.

item.title: RCE in Adobe Acrobat Reader for android(CVE-2021-40724)
